method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: Measured across the street from the two pass 75 panoramas, whose positions were resected there. The north side's base row lies about 0.3 m below theirs, so the cameras stand 1.95 m above these houses. The joint between the two red houses reads 209.3 and 210.1 from the two cameras (209.7 is used); the red and white houses meet at 221.8, 0.6 m east of the district outline's joint, and the zones follow the measurement. The strip with the two gates (x 198.3-202.3) is a yard behind them and is released. Roofs behind the ridges, the chimney heights and the yards are estimates.
